data.long_meaning: Arpit is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arpita’ which means ‘divine, precious, offered, dedicated’. In Hindu mythology, Arpit is a name given to gods and goddesses, symbolizing their divine presence and preciousness. It is also used as a personal name, signifying the bearer's connection to the divine. The name Arpit carries the meaning “Divine, Precious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arpit usually hope their child will grow to embody divine, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
